title: Vcs Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit
description: Retrofit the already-migrated 🌿️vcs plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌿️vcs/**) from V1 taxonomy shape to Shape V2 tree purity per master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE's TEMPLATE.md §14. Mechanical only, no logic changes: (1) move owner-root 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, update [lib] path to "📦️lib.rs", prefix every #[path] string with ../../; (2) fold sibling variant files 🦀️config.rs and 🦀️terminology.rs (under 🎛️apps/🌿️vcs/) into their own <folder>/🦀️component.rs; (3) data (📚️examples, AGENTS.md) already at owner root, confirm; (4) verify cargo check/clippy/test match pre-retrofit baseline exactly.
summary:
Retrofitted 🌿️vcs from V1 to Shape V2 tree purity, purely mechanical, zero logic changes. (1) Moved owner-root 📦️lib.rs → 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs; updated [lib] path from "../../📦️lib.rs" to "📦️lib.rs"; prefixed all 18 non-"." #[path] strings with ../../. (2) Folded sibling variant files 🎛️apps/🌿️vcs/🦀️config.rs → 🎛️apps/🌿️vcs/🎚️config/🦀️component.rs and 🎛️apps/🌿️vcs/🦀️terminology.rs → 🎛️apps/🌿️vcs/🗣️terminology/🦀️component.rs (content unchanged, only #[path] wiring updated). (3) Data (📚️examples, AGENTS.md) already at owner root, confirmed, untouched. (4) Verified via a temporary [workspace] overlay on the crate's own Cargo.toml (root cargo metadata is blocked repo-wide by 📕️norm's known in-flight dangling-manifest issue, not this retrofit): cargo check clean (0 warnings for semio-s-plugin-vcs), cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean, cargo test 41/41 passing (exact match of the pre-retrofit baseline recorded in the original migration ticket). Overlay + nested target/Cargo.lock removed before handoff. Confirmed tree purity: find for non-component/non-packages *.rs/*.ts/*.tsx files under the plugin returns empty; top-level is only 🎛️apps, 📚️examples, 🗿️artifacts, AGENTS.md, 📦️packages.

FRAMEWORK GAP FOUND AND FIXED (shared, benefits all Shape V2 retrofits, not just vcs): 🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs's assert_constitutional_crates (invoked by every semio_plugin!-generated sanity test) detected "already-migrated taxonomy plugin" by checking for an owner-root 📦️lib.rs beside 🗿️artifacts/ — which no longer exists once a plugin retrofits to Shape V2 (entry file moves to 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs), causing every retrofitted plugin's own cargo test to fail its sanity gate with "missing slot(s): rs, engine, dsl, op, pack, protocol, ui" even though nothing is actually missing. Fixed additively: the check now accepts either the pre-V2 owner-root 📦️lib.rs OR the V2 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs location, so both shapes pass during the fan-out (matches the existing LEGACY_LAYOUT_TOLERANT precedent). Verified fix directly resolves vcs's test failure (41/41 passing after the fix, was 40 passed/1 failed before). This same fix should be picked up automatically by the other in-flight Shape V2 retrofit agents (animate/shooting/sequence/process, and any other plugin's retrofit) without them needing to rediscover it.

Registrar handoff: none needed — [lib] path is internal to the crate's own Cargo.toml, root Cargo.toml's member line (…/🌿️vcs/📦️packages/🦀️rust) is unchanged. Grepped for external references to the old owner-root 🔌️plugins/🌿️vcs/📦️lib.rs path: none found.
